title: Ifeoma Asiagwu — Extern's 4-week Corporate Strategy Externship with Eric Ries is live and uses the Incorruptible framework
summary: Ifeoma Asiagwu — operations professional — announces the start of a 4-week Corporate Strategy Externship with Eric Ries and Extern, working through the Incorruptible framework: analyzing companies beyond surface-level performance, identifying signs of mission drift and organizational risk, evaluating governance and decision-making structures, and turning analysis into strategic recommendations. Live evidence of the externship's Incorruptible curriculum.
blockquote: I'm excited to share that I've started a 4-week Corporate Strategy Externship with Eric Ries and Extern. We'll be working through the Incorruptible framework to understand how companies stay healthy over the long term, including how to: Analyse companies beyond their surface-level performance; Identify signs of mission drift and organisational risk; Evaluate governance and decision-making structures; Turn analysis into practical strategic recommendations.
